briefing.ja: 小さな会社のオフィスで、午後の誕生日会に出すはずのホールケーキが給湯室から消えた。無くなったのは15時から15時30分の間である。その時間にフロアにいた6人のうち1人が犯人であり、その人の証言カードには嘘が1枚だけ混ざっている。全員の証言を突き合わせて、誰の話が成り立たないかを見つける。
briefing.en: A whole birthday cake, meant for the party that afternoon, was taken from the office kitchenette between 15:00 and 15:30. One of the six people on the floor is the culprit, and one card in that person's hand is a lie.

text.2: The front desk was empty from 15:10.
text.3: I left the front desk at ten past and nobody took over.
text.4: Nobody was covering the front desk after ten past, as far as I know.
text.5: I could not tell you the minute I walked away, but the front desk was left empty from about ten past three.

facts.hintJa: front desk = 受付 / empty = 誰もいない / cover = 代わりに担当する

text.2: The fire door was locked until 15:20.
text.3: The fire door stayed locked until twenty past three.
text.4: The fire door key hangs at reception, and nobody had signed it out before twenty past.
text.5: I would not stake my life on it, but I am fairly sure the fire door stayed locked until at least twenty past three.

facts.hintJa: fire door = 非常口 / locked = 鍵がかかっている / stay = 〜のままである

text.2: I stood at the printer in the corridor from 15:10 to 15:20.
text.3: I was at the printer in the corridor from ten past to twenty past.
text.4: I had the whole corridor in front of me while I waited for my printouts, from ten past to twenty past.
text.5: I was not really watching the time, but I stood at the printer in the corridor from about ten past to twenty past three.

facts.hintJa: printer = 印刷機 / corridor = 廊下 / stand = 立つ

text.2: The meeting room door was locked until 15:20.
text.3: The meeting room stayed locked until twenty past three.
text.4: Nobody could have been in there while that door was locked.
text.5: I could not say who has the key, but the meeting room door stayed locked until about twenty past three.

facts.hintJa: meeting room = 会議室 / locked = 鍵がかかっている / key = 鍵

text.1: Cake box. In the kitchenette. At 15:10.
text.2: The cake box was still in the kitchenette at 15:10.
text.3: I am sure the cake box was still on the kitchenette table at ten past.
text.4: The box was certainly still there when I went in for water at ten past.
text.5: The box was still sitting there when I went in for water, and that would have been around ten past three.

facts.hintJa: cake box = ケーキの箱 / kitchenette = 給湯室 / still = まだ

text.2: Every chair at the sales desks was pushed in from 15:10 to 15:20.
text.3: All the chairs in the sales row stayed pushed in until twenty past.
text.4: A chair pushed right in is a chair nobody is sitting on, and they stayed like that until twenty past.
text.5: I am not going to argue about a minute or two, but every chair in the sales row stayed pushed in from ten past until twenty past three.

facts.hintJa: chair = 椅子 / push in = 押し込む / row = 並び

text.1: The lift. Out of order. 15:05 to 15:25.
text.2: The lift was out of order between 15:05 and 15:25.
text.3: I put the out-of-order sign on the lift at five past three and took it off at twenty-five past.
text.4: With my sign taped to the door, that lift was not going anywhere.
text.5: I did not check it every minute, but the sign stayed on the lift from five past until twenty-five past three.

facts.hintJa: lift = エレベーター / out of order = 故障中 / sign = 貼り紙

text.1: Boxes. By the fire door. Until 15:25.
text.2: Delivery boxes stood by the fire door until 15:25.
text.3: The boxes I unpacked stood in front of the fire door until twenty-five past.
text.4: Anyone going that way would have had to climb over my boxes.
text.5: I was slow clearing them away, but the delivery boxes stood in front of the fire door until about twenty-five past three.

facts.hintJa: box = 箱 / stack = 積む / fire door = 非常口

text.2: The cake box was gone at 15:20.
text.3: I went to the kitchenette at twenty past and the box had gone.
text.4: By the time I looked in, there was nothing on that table at all.
text.5: I would hesitate to give an exact time, but the cake box had already gone when I looked in at about twenty past three.

facts.hintJa: gone = なくなっている / look in = のぞく / table = 台

text.2: No calls came in between 15:05 and 15:25.
text.3: The phone log shows no calls between five past and twenty-five past.
text.4: If a call had come in, it would be sitting in the log with a time next to it.
text.5: The log is not something I read for pleasure, but it shows no call came in between five past and twenty-five past three.

facts.hintJa: call = 電話 / log = 記録 / show = 示す

text.1: My bucket. In the back corridor. Until 15:20.
text.2: My mop bucket stood in the back corridor until 15:20.
text.3: My bucket and my wet-floor sign stood in the back corridor until twenty past.
text.4: Nobody goes down that corridor while the wet-floor sign is out, and mine was out until twenty past.
text.5: I never put it away as soon as I should, but my bucket and wet-floor sign stood in the back corridor until about twenty past three.

facts.hintJa: bucket = バケツ / corridor = 廊下 / wet-floor sign = 床が濡れている表示

text.2: The storeroom was locked between 15:10 and 15:20.
text.3: I locked the storeroom at ten past and kept the key in my pocket.
text.4: The only key was on me, so that room stayed shut from ten past to twenty past.
text.5: I always lock it when I leave, and I had the key in my pocket from ten past until twenty past three.

facts.hintJa: storeroom = 倉庫 / lock = 鍵をかける / key = 鍵

text.2: I was in the storeroom at 15:15.
text.3: I went into the storeroom to fetch paper cups at a quarter past.
text.4: I had gone through to the storeroom by then, so I saw nothing of the floor.
text.5: I honestly could not name the minute, but I had gone through into the storeroom by about a quarter past three.

lie.hintJa: storeroom = 倉庫 / fetch = 取りに行く / paper cup = 紙コップ

contradictions.meaningJa: Hanaは15:15に倉庫にいたと言うが、倉庫は15:10に施錠され、鍵はかけた本人が持っていたという証言がある。Emiの15:10の証言とGoroの15:20の証言で無くなった時間帯が絞られ、Sotaの廊下での位置とRikuのエレベーターの貼り紙で、その間にフロアを離れられた者がいないことが分かる。

text.2: I was at my desk at 15:15.
text.3: I was sitting at my own desk at about a quarter past three.
text.4: I had gone back to my desk by then and never got up again.
text.5: You will have to take my word on the timing, but I was back at my own desk by about a quarter past three.

lie.hintJa: own = 自分の / desk = 机 / sit = 座る

contradictions.meaningJa: Sotaは15:15に自分の机にいたと言うが、Emiは15:10から15:20の間、営業の机の椅子はどれも押し込まれたままだったと言っている。Hanaの非常口の施錠とRikuのエレベーターの貼り紙でフロアの外へ出た者がいないことが分かり、掃除のバケツが裏の廊下をふさいでいたことと、Goroの15:20の証言で残りの経路と時間帯が絞られる。

text.1: Me. In the meeting room. At 15:15.
text.2: I was in the meeting room at 15:15.
text.3: I went into the meeting room to lay out the plates at a quarter past.
text.4: I had gone in to set the table by then, so I was not on the floor.
text.5: I was in and out with the plates, so I could only say I had gone into the meeting room by around a quarter past three.

lie.hintJa: meeting room = 会議室 / lay out = 並べる / plate = 皿

contradictions.meaningJa: Emiは15:15に会議室で皿を並べていたと言うが、Sotaは15:20まで会議室の扉が施錠されていたと言っている。Hanaの受付が空だったという証言、Rikuの非常口をふさいだ箱、掃除のバケツがふさいだ裏の廊下で他の経路も使えず、Goroの15:20の証言で無くなった時間帯の終わりが分かる。

text.1: Me. Front desk. A call. At 15:15.
text.2: I was at the front desk taking a call at 15:15.
text.3: I was covering the front desk and took a call at a quarter past.
text.4: I was on the phone at the front desk, so I was nowhere near the kitchenette.
text.5: I would have to check with the caller, but I believe I was answering the phone at the front desk at around a quarter past three.

lie.hintJa: front desk = 受付 / take a call = 電話に出る / cover = 代わりに担当する

contradictions.meaningJa: Rikuは15:15に受付で電話に出ていたと言うが、Hanaは15:10以降、受付には誰もいなかったと言っている。Goroの電話の記録にもその時間帯の着信はない。Emiの15:10の証言、Sotaの廊下での位置、掃除のバケツがふさいだ裏の廊下で、その間のフロアの様子が分かる。

text.1: Me. Out the fire door. At 15:15.
text.2: I went out through the fire door at 15:15.
text.3: I stepped out through the fire door for some air at a quarter past.
text.4: I had stepped outside for a moment, so I was not in the office at all.
text.5: Most afternoons I take a moment outside, and I think I was out through the fire door at around a quarter past three.

lie.hintJa: fire door = 非常口 / step out = 外へ出る / air = 外の空気

contradictions.meaningJa: Goroは15:15に非常口から外へ出たと言うが、Hanaは非常口が15:20まで施錠されていたと言っている。Rikuの箱もその扉の前に積まれていた。Emiの15:10の証言、Sotaの廊下での位置、掃除のバケツがふさいだ裏の廊下で、その時間帯にフロアを離れた者がいないことが分かる。

text.2: I was in the lift at 15:15.
text.3: I took the rubbish down in the lift at about a quarter past three.
text.4: I had gone down with the rubbish by then, so I was not on this floor.
text.5: It is what I always do after lunch, and I am fairly sure I took the rubbish down in the lift at around a quarter past three.

lie.hintJa: lift = エレベーター / rubbish = ごみ / take down = 下へ運ぶ

contradictions.meaningJa: Naoは15:15にエレベーターでごみを下ろしたと言うが、Rikuは15:05から15:25までエレベーターに故障中の貼り紙を出していたと言っている。Emiの15:10の証言とGoroの15:20の証言で時間帯が絞られ、Hanaの受付の証言とSotaの廊下での位置で、その間のフロアの様子が分かる。

timelineEn: 15:05 The intern put an out-of-order sign on the lift.
15:10 The cake box was still in the kitchenette.
15:15 Someone carried the cake box out of the kitchenette.
15:20 The manager looked in and the box had gone.
15:25 The party started with no cake on the table.

keyExpressions.en: Where were you at a quarter past?

keyExpressions.ja: 誰かが言っていたのですが…

keyExpressions.en: It must have been around then.
keyExpressions.ja: たしかその頃だったはずです。
それはおかしいです。なぜなら…
